title: Xiaomi 11T Pro + Nusantara ROM Fastboot & Sideload Guide
blurb: Nusantara ROM on the Xiaomi 11T Pro — the fastboot and sideload flash, plus the recovery you'll want running before any of it.
video_description:
Nusantara ROM on the Xiaomi 11T Pro — the fastboot and sideload flash, plus the recovery you'll want running before any of it.

Nusantara is a custom ROM that lands on the 11T Pro through fastboot plus a recovery sideload, and the part people trip on is the A/B side of things. Boot and vendor_boot both go to the _ab slots, and if you skip one the phone won't even boot into recovery. Get that right and the rest is simple: sideload the ROM zip, factory reset, reboot. Clean, quick, and easy to undo if you keep a stock package around.

🧰 What You Need
• A custom recovery image for the 11T Pro — link below
• The Nusantara ROM zip
• Platform Tools on the PC
• A backup, because a factory reset is part of the process

⌨️ Fastboot, Line by Line
• adb reboot bootloader
• fastboot flash boot_ab boot.img
• fastboot flash vendor_boot_ab vendor_boot.img
• fastboot reboot recovery

📲 Then In Recovery
• Wipe data, which is the factory reset option
• Select apply update from ADB
• From the PC, sideload the ROM zip
• Reboot and let the first boot finish — give it a few minutes

⚠️ Where People Get Stuck
• Flashing only one of boot and vendor_boot. Both are needed.
• Sideloading with the wrong recovery booted, which fails without a clear reason.
• Skipping the factory reset, then wondering why the system hangs on boot.
